GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 432 (6 Feb 46) ESS/IE
(SCAPIN - 709)
APO 500
6 February 1946
MEMORANDUM FOR : The Imperial Japanese Government
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo
SUBJECT : Shipment of Vegetable Seeds to Korea
1. It is directed that immediate action be taken to effect the shipment to Inchon, Korea of the following vegetable seeds:
Carrot 1,500 Kilograms
Cabbage 5,800 Kilograms
Japanese Leek 10,000 Kilograms
Onion 2,000 Kilograms
2. This shipment will be properly marked and consigned to the Commanding General, United States Forces in Korea.
3. The assembly, packing and transportation arrangements will be completed and delivered to the port of shipment as soon as practicable, This Headquarters will be advised the date of loading, name of ship, and sailing date. A copy of the ocean bill of lading will be attached.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
/s/ H. W. Allen
for /t/ B. M. FITCH,
Brigadier General, AGD,
Adjutant General

MEMO FOR RECORD: (SCAPIN - 709)
WFM/HZ/rnr
29 January 1946
1. Reference is made to:
a. TFYMG 697 of 17 January 1946 from USAFIK to SCAP, attached, requesting shipment of vegetable seeds to Korea.
b. ZA 12922 of 14 January 1946 from SCAP to USAFIK, attached, offering the vegetable seeds to USAFIK.
c. Check sheet NR 464.8 (2 January 1946) A from Natural Resources Section, attached, stating availability of seeds.
2. This directive requests the Imperial Japanese Government to prepare for shipment the quantities as stated in TFYMG 697.
